newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Mark seen extending weakness below 65 yen.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Mark seen extending weakness below 65 yen.

text.p: The mark is set to extend its weakness to the next downside target at 65 yen after slumping to a fresh low of 65.22 in morning Europe, technical analysts said.
Only a move above the 66 area would avert the bearish bias but chartists expected an extension of the downmove to support at 64.50 before a short-term base can be found.

"The 65 level is the next big target," said Stuart Frost, market analyst at NatWest Markets in London. "There may be a bounce then to 66 some time this week, but I'm looking for another sharp drop to 63."
